Build OVERHAUL PHASE 1 of the Nxeon Cold Email Engine — the Reply Loop + Master Inbox — to make it feel like a flagship platform (Smartlead/Instantly-class). Nxeon = Next.js App Router + Prisma + Postgres at /opt/nxeon.

READ FIRST: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/projects/coldemail/overhaul-plan.md (the audit + full plan), and the existing CE code: prisma/schema.prisma (Business/Contact/Brand/EmailList/Suppression/ColdCampaign/SequenceStep/ColdSend/EmailEvent/SendingDomain/Inbox/WarmupState/DeliverabilityEvent/etc.), lib/coldemail/* (compliance, sender, warmup, rotation, analytics, feedback, dns), worker/coldemail*.ts, lib/actions-coldemail.ts, app/admin/coldemail/*, components/admin/coldemail/*, and lib/crypto-box.ts (encrypt/decrypt secrets), lib/anthropic.ts (askClaude), lib/mailer.ts (SMTP pattern).

ISOLATION (mandatory — a prior run broke prod otherwise): First `cd /opt/nxeon && git worktree add /opt/nxeon-build-inbox -b feature/coldemail-overhaul-inbox main`. Work ONLY in /opt/nxeon-build-inbox. NEVER touch /opt/nxeon or /opt/nxeon-staging. Run `cd /opt/nxeon-build-inbox && npm ci`. NEVER systemctl/deploy/prisma-db-push/edit-.env. Verify pwd+branch before building. `npx tsc --noEmit` MUST be 0 errors (full `next build` can't finish in the worktree — no DATABASE_URL — that's expected; rely on tsc + tests).

=== SAFETY ===
- The bulk-send master switch (`cold_email_sending_enabled`) stays OFF and unchanged — bulk campaigns still don't fire. 
- IMAP/SMTP polling + reply-send are INERT until an inbox has real credentials configured (no creds = nothing connects). Store all creds ENCRYPTED via lib/crypto-box (never plaintext, never logged).
- A manual 1:1 reply the operator types to someone who replied to them is normal email and may send from that inbox's SMTP even while the bulk switch is off — but only to an existing conversation (not bulk).
- If a reply is an unsubscribe/opt-out request, auto-add a GLOBAL Suppression.

=== DELIVERABLES (additive schema; keep names consistent) ===
1) Inbox creds: add to `Inbox` — imapHost/imapPort/imapUser/imapPassEnc, smtpHost/smtpPort/smtpUser/smtpPassEnc, imapTls/smtpTls bools, lastPolledAt. UI on the Domains/Inboxes admin page to set them (passwords write-only, encrypted).
2) `Conversation` (contactId, campaignId?, inboxId, subject, status enum OPEN/REPLIED/INTERESTED/NOT_INTERESTED/AUTO_REPLY/OUT_OF_OFFICE/UNSUBSCRIBE/CLOSED, lastMessageAt, unread bool) + `Message` (conversationId, direction OUTBOUND/INBOUND, fromAddr, toAddr, subject, bodyText, bodyHtml, messageId, inReplyTo, references, sentAt/receivedAt, coldSendId?). Add `stage` enum on `Contact` (NEW/CONTACTED/REPLIED/INTERESTED/MEETING_BOOKED/WON/LOST, default NEW) for the pipeline start.
3) IMAP poller worker/coldemail-inbox.ts (register in worker/index.ts, guarded): for each Inbox with IMAP creds, connect (use `imapflow`), fetch new messages since lastPolledAt, parse (use `mailparser`), match each to a Contact (by from-address) + the originating ColdSend (by In-Reply-To/References/recipient), upsert a Conversation + append an INBOUND Message, mark the Contact `stage=REPLIED`, HALT that contact's remaining sequence sends (cancel pending ColdSends for the contact/campaign), then classify the reply via askClaude (INTERESTED / NOT_INTERESTED / AUTO_REPLY / OUT_OF_OFFICE / UNSUBSCRIBE) and set conversation.status + contact.stage accordingly; UNSUBSCRIBE → global Suppression. Degrade gracefully with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (leave status OPEN). Add imapflow + mailparser to package.json.
4) Reply/compose send: lib/coldemail/inbox-send.ts — send a threaded reply (In-Reply-To/References set) from the conversation's inbox SMTP (reuse the sender transport, per-inbox creds), log an OUTBOUND Message, mark conversation read. Server action gated to requireArea("platform").
5) MASTER INBOX UI: new nav tab "Inbox" under the Cold Email section → /admin/coldemail/inbox. A unified conversation list across all inboxes (filters: unread / by status / by campaign / by inbox), a thread view (messages in order), a reply composer (sends from the right inbox), and status controls (mark interested / not-interested / meeting-booked / closed). Make it feel like a real unibox (clean, dense, keyboard-friendly). Show which inbox each conversation belongs to. Reuse components/ui/primitives + the coldemail component patterns.
6) Webhooks: `WebhookEndpoint` (url, secretEnc, events[], active) + fire HMAC-signed POSTs on reply / interested / unsubscribe events; a small admin page under Cold Email settings to manage endpoints (test-fire button).
7) Tests (tsx --test): reply→send matching, threading header build, unsubscribe→suppression, classification-result→status mapping. Update docs/DOCUMENTATION.md.

FINISH: in /opt/nxeon-build-inbox — `npx prisma generate` + `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; tests pass; commit + `git push -u origin feature/coldemail-overhaul-inbox`. Report: schema added, the poller/match/halt/classify flow, the inbox UI, deps added, build/test results, and the staging command. Do NOT deploy.

1	# Cold Email Engine — Flagship Overhaul Plan
2	
3	**Compiled 2026-08-11 (READ-ONLY audit — no code changed).** Target: take the Nxeon Cold Email
4	add-on (`/opt/nxeon`, Next.js App Router + Prisma + Postgres) from a correct-but-barebones
5	*sender* to a flagship-class *outreach platform* (Instantly / Smartlead / Apollo / Lemlist tier).
6	
7	The honest one-line verdict: **the compliance + deliverability engine is genuinely strong — arguably
8	better-architected than most competitors — but the product is send-only. It has no eyes and no
9	memory: it never reads a reply, never scores a lead, and gives the operator forms instead of a
10	workspace.** That is exactly why it feels barebones, and it is fixable without touching the good core.
11	
12	---
13	
14	## 1. Current state — honest inventory (what's built / stubbed / missing)
15	
16	### Data model (`prisma/schema.prisma`) — **BUILT, solid**
17	Full Phase 1–3 schema exists and is well-commented: `Business`, `Contact` (+ `EmailStatus`),
18	`Brand` (sending identity), `EmailList`/`EmailListMember`, `Suppression` (GLOBAL/BRAND scope),
19	`ConsentRecord`, `ColdCampaign`, `SequenceStep`, `ColdSend`, `EmailEvent`, plus the deliverability
20	layer: `SendingDomain`, `Inbox`, `WarmupState`, `DeliverabilityEvent`, `PlacementTest`,
21	`MetricsDaily`, `HealthSnapshot`, and every enum. Additive, migration-safe.
22	- **Gaps in the model:** `SequenceStep` has only `subject/bodyMarkdown/delayDays` — **no condition,
23	  no A/B variant, no channel**. `Contact` has **no CRM stage/owner/status** and **no custom-field
24	  store**. `Inbox` declares `provider` (GMAIL/M365/SMTP/POSTAL/KUMO) but has **no SMTP/IMAP
25	  credential fields** — so "rotation" is really From-header rotation over one shared Mailcow relay,
26	  not per-mailbox sending. There is **no `Template`, no `Reply`/`Conversation`, no `ApiKey`/
27	  `Webhook`, no `Workspace`/tenant** model.
28	
29	### Compliance (`lib/coldemail/compliance.ts`, `feedback.ts`) — **BUILT, flagship-grade**
30	Suppression matching (email+domain, global/brand tiers), stateless HMAC one-click unsubscribe (RFC
31	8058), open/click tokens, CAN-SPAM footer + postal-address enforcement, brand readiness checks,
32	**reputation isolation** (protected-domain set blocks cold-sending from `nxeon.cloud`), and a
33	complaint-rate **circuit breaker** that auto-pauses a brand (`feedback.ts`). This is a real
34	differentiator — keep it as the spine. **Stub:** `recordFeedback` is fed only by a manual action /
35	webhook *seam* (`app/api/coldemail/feedback/route.ts`) — no live SES-SNS or Mailcow FBL wired.
36	
37	### Sending (`lib/coldemail/sender.ts`, `worker/coldemail.ts`) — **BUILT but single-relay + gated OFF**
38	Pure message rendering (markdown→HTML, `{{var}}` substitution, tracking injection), a `MailTransport`
39	interface with a working `NxeonSmtpTransport` and a **stub `SesTransport`**. The send worker is
40	correct and careful: idempotent scheduling, send-time suppression re-check, per-inbox warmup cap,
41	send-window, jittered throttle, rotation attribution. **Hard-gated behind `cold_email_sending_enabled`
42	(default false) — nothing sends today.** Limitation: all mail leaves via one platform SMTP config
43	(`loadSmtpConfig` reads global `Setting` rows); the inbox only changes the `From`.
44	
45	### Warmup + rotation (`warmup.ts`, `rotation.ts`, `worker/coldemail-deliverability.ts`) — **BUILT (mechanics), synthetic engagement out of scope**
46	Pure ramp math (presets, adaptive health back-off, planned-vs-actual curve), rotation selection
47	(LRU + min-gap + cap), and health-based **auto-pause** (bounce/complaint thresholds straight from
48	research §4). A warmup sweep recomputes ramp caps and auto-promotes WARMING→ACTIVE. **Missing by
49	design:** there is no actual warmup *traffic* — no pool sends, no seed replies, no spam-rescue. The
50	`WarmupState.warmupReplies/spamRescues` columns are never populated. (Correct call — a real warmup
51	network can't be self-hosted — but the UI currently implies activity that doesn't happen.)
52	
53	### Analytics (`lib/coldemail/analytics.ts`) — **BUILT, honest, but shallow presentation**
54	Excellent rate derivation and the **2026 open-rate honesty posture** (opens surfaced but flagged
55	MPP-unreliable, never a health input; reply/positive-reply are the hero KPIs) — a genuine
56	flagship-quality opinion competitors lack. Composite health score excludes opens. **Gaps:** rollups
57	are count tiles only — no time-series charts, **no step-level or variant-level breakdown**, and the
58	hero reply metrics **are always zero because nothing ingests replies** (see below).
59	
60	### UI/UX (`app/admin/coldemail/*`, `components/admin/coldemail/*`) — **BARE — this is the felt problem**
61	Ten server-rendered pages (overview, businesses, lists, brands, campaigns, campaign detail, domains,
62	warming, analytics, suppression, settings). Everything is a **plain form + list**: sequence = an
63	`<ol>` of steps with an "Add a step" form (`campaigns/[id]/page.tsx`); domains/inboxes/seed-tests are
64	number-input forms (`Phase3Controls.tsx`). No drag-and-drop builder, no inbox/triage view, no
65	pipeline board, no charts, no template gallery. Functional, on-theme, but visibly a control panel,
66	not a product.
67	
68	### The decisive missing subsystem: **REPLY INGESTION**
69	`EmailEventType.REPLY/POSITIVE_REPLY` exist and roll up, but **no code path writes them**. There is
70	**no IMAP poller, no reply parser, no conversation store, no inbox UI.** The platform is deaf: it can
71	send a sequence but cannot see that someone answered, cannot stop follow-ups on reply from the mail
72	side, cannot categorize interested vs not, cannot book a meeting. Every flagship competitor's
73	headline feature (unibox / master inbox) is precisely this, and it is 0% built.
74	
75	---
76	
77	## 2. Gap analysis vs flagship (2026)
78	
79	Legend: **Yes** = comparable to flagship · **Partial** = present but thin/stubbed · **No** = absent.
80	
81	| Capability | Flagship has it | We have it | Impact |
82	|---|---|---|---|
83	| SPF/DKIM/DMARC auth + verifier | ✅ | **Yes** (`dns.ts`, authoritative-NS verify) | — strong |
84	| One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) | ✅ | **Yes** | — strong |
85	| Suppression / DNC (global + scoped) | ✅ | **Yes** | — strong |
86	| Consent / lawful-basis records (GDPR/CASL) | Partial (most weak here) | **Yes** | **differentiator** |
87	| Reputation isolation + complaint circuit breaker | ✅ | **Yes** | **differentiator** |
88	| Warmup ramp + health auto-pause | ✅ | **Partial** (math yes; no real warmup traffic) | med |
89	| Domain/inbox rotation | ✅ | **Partial** (From-rotation over 1 relay; no per-mailbox creds) | **high** |
90	| Honest MPP-aware analytics | ✗ (most still lead w/ opens) | **Yes** | **differentiator** |
91	| **Unified master inbox / unibox** | ✅ (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist) | **No** | **critical** |
92	| **Reply capture (IMAP) + threading** | ✅ | **No** | **critical** |
93	| **AI reply categorization** (interested / meeting / OOO / not-interested…) | ✅ (Smartlead 9 buckets) | **No** | **high** |
94	| AI reply drafting | ✅ | **No** | med |
95	| **Visual sequence builder w/ conditions + branches** | ✅ (Smartlead subsequences, Woodpecker branches) | **No** (linear steps only) | **high** |
96	| **A/B variants per step, auto-winner** | ✅ (Woodpecker ≤5 variants) | **No** | **high** |
97	| **Spintax + rich personalization / custom fields** | ✅ (Lemlist liquid, dynamic images) | **Partial** (5 hardcoded `{{vars}}`) | **high** |
98	| **CRM / lead pipeline w/ statuses** | ✅ (Instantly & Smartlead built-in CRM) | **No** | **high** |
99	| **Pre-send email verification** | ✅ (Instantly, Woodpecker, Bouncer) | **No** (post-send bounce only) | **high** |
100	| **Deliverability suite** (placement test API, blacklist monitor, spam-word checker) | ✅ | **Partial** (manual seed entry; no API, no blacklist, no content lint) | **high** |

112	## 3. Overhaul plan — prioritized, phased build spec
113	
114	Guiding principle: **do NOT rebuild the engine.** The compliance/warmup/rotation/analytics core is
115	the moat. Build the *product* on top of it — the reply loop, the builder, the pipeline, the polish.
116	Everything below is additive to the schema (matches the codebase's append-only discipline).

120	
121	- **`Inbox` gets real credentials** (schema): `smtpHost/smtpPort/smtpUser/smtpPassEnc/smtpSecure`,
122	  `imapHost/imapPort/imapUser/imapPassEnc`, `lastImapUid`, `lastPolledAt`. Encrypt with the existing
123	  `crypto-box`. Makes rotation *real* (each inbox its own mailbox) and unlocks IMAP.
124	- **IMAP poller** (`worker/coldemail-inbox.ts` + `lib/coldemail/imap.ts`): per-ACTIVE-inbox poll,
125	  match `In-Reply-To`/`References`/threading + recipient back to a `ColdSend`, write a `REPLY`
126	  `DeliverabilityEvent` **and an `EmailEvent`**, and — critically — **auto-halt remaining queued
127	  sends for that contact** (mail-side reply detection, the thing follow-up logic hinges on).
128	- **New models:** `Conversation` (contactId, campaignId, inboxId, subject, status, lastMessageAt,
129	  category, assignee) and `Message` (conversationId, direction in/out, fromInbox, raw, snippet,
130	  sentAt). Threading store for the unibox.
131	- **Master Inbox UI** (`/admin/coldemail/inbox`): unified list of conversations across all
132	  campaigns/brands/inboxes, filters (unread / interested / meeting / needs-reply), a thread view,
133	  and **reply-from-the-right-inbox** compose (reuses `sender.ts` rendering, sends via that inbox's
134	  SMTP). This is the single most flagship-defining screen.
135	- **Reply categorization**: rule-based first (OOO / auto-reply / unsubscribe-phrase / bounce
136	  detection), then an **AI classifier** into Smartlead-style buckets (Interested / Meeting Request /
137	  Info Request / Not Interested / Do Not Contact / OOO / Wrong Person). Uses the Anthropic API
138	  already available to the platform — *no new external ESP dependency*.
139	- **Outbound webhooks** (`Webhook` model + dispatcher): fire on `reply`, `positive_reply`, `bounce`,
140	  `unsubscribe`, `meeting_booked` so Nxeon/CRMs can subscribe. Cheap, high "platform" signal.
141	- **Wire real feedback**: connect SES-SNS / Mailcow FBL into `recordFeedback` so bounces/complaints
142	  arrive live, not by hand.
143

145	existing kill-switch). But **IMAP reply capture works the moment one real mailbox exists** — you can
146	demo the entire inbox/reply/categorize loop on a single test mailbox without flipping the send
147	switch. New subsystem (not polish): IMAP poller, conversation store, inbox UI, classifier, webhooks.

151	rate (personalization).

154	  `channel` (EMAIL for now), and a child **`StepVariant`** (subject, bodyMarkdown, weight, isControl)
155	  so A/B variants live under a step; `ColdSend.variantId` for attribution. `Contact` gains a
156	  **`customFields Json`** bag; `ContactList` import maps arbitrary CSV columns into it.
157	- **Spintax engine** (`lib/coldemail/spintax.ts`, pure/testable): `{Hi|Hey|Hello}` expansion, seeded
158	  per-send so it's deterministic + auditable; extend `substitute()` to resolve `{{customField}}` and
159	  add **fallbacks** (`{{firstName|there}}`). Research §3: sentence-level variation is where the
160	  deliverability lift is — support paragraph blocks, not just word-level.
161	- **Visual builder UI** (client component): a vertical step canvas with delay chips, condition
162	  branches, per-step variant tabs with live reply/positive-reply per variant, and a
163	  **personalization preview** against a sample contact. Replace the current "Add a step" form.
164	- **Variant analytics**: extend the rollup to group by `variantId`; auto-surface the winning variant.
165	- **Template library** (`Template` model + `/admin/coldemail/templates`): save/reuse subject+body
166	  blocks, seed a starter gallery. Pure UI/CRUD on top of existing rendering.

168	Mostly pure/UI work — no external creds. New subsystem: spintax + variant engine + builder UI.
169	
170	### Phase 3 — **CRM / Lead Pipeline + Pre-send Verification + Deliverability Suite**
171	- **Lead pipeline:** `Contact` (or a new `Lead`) gains `stage` (NEW / CONTACTED / INTERESTED /
172	  MEETING_BOOKED / WON / LOST / DNC), `ownerId`, `lastActivityAt`; a **kanban board**
173	  (`/admin/coldemail/pipeline`) mirroring the existing `/admin/agency/pipeline` pattern. Reply

176	  checks locally now; ZeroBounce/Bouncer/NeverBounce adapter behind an interface (creds-gated).

178	  Populate the existing but unused `Contact.emailStatus`.
179	- **Deliverability suite** completion: **blacklist monitor** (query Spamhaus/Barracuda DNSBLs for

181	  creds), **spam-word / content linter** on step bodies pre-send, and a **placement-test API adapter**

184	  health trend lines. Presentation upgrade over the solid existing math.

192	- **Public REST API + `ApiKey`** model (create leads, launch campaigns, read stats) — turns it into a
193	  platform Nxeon's other ventures can drive.
194	- **Lead sourcing/enrichment** (Apollo/PDL/Hunter behind the licensing guardrails already documented
195	  in `architecture.md` §3) — the only piece with real ToS/legal gating.

198	1. **Live outbound sending** — a real dedicated sending domain + ESP (SES) or Mailcow inboxes, then
199	   flip `cold_email_sending_enabled`. Everything else can be built and demoed without it.
200	2. **Per-inbox IMAP/SMTP creds** — needed for real rotation + reply capture. *One* test mailbox is

211	  time-series/variant charts, warming activity feed honesty, unified nav shell.

216	
217	**Build the unified Master Inbox with live IMAP reply capture (Phase 1).**
218	
219	It is the one change that flips the product's whole identity. Today the engine is *deaf* — it sends
220	sequences but has zero visibility into answers, so its own hero metric (reply / positive-reply rate)
221	is structurally always zero, follow-up-stops-on-reply can't work, and there is nothing for an
222	operator to *do* between campaign launches. Every flagship (Instantly Unibox, Smartlead Master Inbox,
223	Lemlist unified inbox) leads with exactly this screen because it is where outreach becomes a
224	conversation and a booked meeting. It also uniquely leverages what's already strong here — the
225	tracking/suppression/threading spine and the Anthropic API for categorization/drafting — and it is
226	**demoable on a single real mailbox without ever enabling bulk sending**, sidestepping the deploy
227	gate. Ship the reply loop and the platform stops feeling like a send tool and starts feeling like

## Cold Email Engine — OVERHAUL Phase 1: the Reply Loop + Master Inbox (2026-08-11)

Turns the send-only engine into a **two-way platform**. Before this, the engine was *deaf*: it sent
sequences but never read a reply, so its hero KPI (reply / positive-reply rate) was structurally always
zero, follow-ups couldn't stop on a mail-side reply, and there was no operator workspace between launches.
This phase adds an **IMAP reply poller**, a **conversation store**, a **unified Master Inbox (unibox)**, an
**AI reply classifier**, and **outbound webhooks**. Built on branch `feature/coldemail-overhaul-inbox`.
Additive to Phase 1/2/3 — no existing model/enum value changed.

**Safety posture.** The bulk kill-switch `cold_email_sending_enabled` stays **off** — bulk campaigns still
don't fire. IMAP polling + reply-send are **inert until an inbox has real credentials** (a blank `imapHost`/
`smtpHost` is never contacted). A 1:1 operator reply to someone who already replied is *normal* email and
may send from that inbox's SMTP even while the bulk switch is off — it never touches the bulk queue. Every
credential + webhook secret is stored **encrypted** via `lib/crypto-box` (write-only in the UI, never logged,
never echoed back). The whole reply loop is demoable on a **single real mailbox** without enabling bulk send.

### New data models (additive)
- **`Conversation`** — one reply thread per contact per mailbox, `@@unique([inboxId, contactId])` so the
  poller upserts idempotently. Fields: `contactId`, `campaignId?`, `inboxId`, `subject`, `status`
  (`ConversationStatus`: OPEN/REPLIED/INTERESTED/NOT_INTERESTED/AUTO_REPLY/OUT_OF_OFFICE/UNSUBSCRIBE/CLOSED),
  `category` (raw classifier label), `lastMessageAt`, `unread`.
- **`Message`** — one message in a thread. `direction` (`MessageDirection` OUTBOUND/INBOUND), `fromAddr`,
  `toAddr`, `subject`, `bodyText`, `bodyHtml`, RFC threading headers (`messageId`, `inReplyTo`, `references`),
  `coldSendId?` (the send an inbound reply answered), `sentAt`/`receivedAt`.
- **`WebhookEndpoint`** — `url`, `secretEnc` (encrypted HMAC secret), `events String[]` (reply | interested |
  unsubscribe), `active`, `lastFiredAt`, `lastStatus`.
- **`Inbox`** gains real per-mailbox credentials: `smtpHost/Port/User/PassEnc/Tls`,
  `imapHost/Port/User/PassEnc/Tls`, `lastImapUid`, `lastPolledAt`. Makes rotation *actually* per-mailbox and
  unlocks IMAP.
- **`Contact`** gains `stage` (`ContactStage`: NEW/CONTACTED/REPLIED/INTERESTED/MEETING_BOOKED/WON/LOST,
  default NEW) — the lead-pipeline start.
- **`ColdSendStatus`** gains `CANCELLED` (append-only) — a queued follow-up halted because the contact replied.
  Terminal, so the send worker (which only sends QUEUED) never touches it and the campaign still completes.

### Pure, tested logic (no DB/IO)
- **`lib/coldemail/threading.ts`** — `extractMessageIds`, `normalizeMessageId`, `replySubject` (prefixes
  `Re:` once), `buildThreadHeaders` (In-Reply-To + a de-duped, order-preserving References chain).
- **`lib/coldemail/inbox-match.ts`** — `buildSentIndex` + `matchColdSendId`: threads an inbound reply back to
  the ColdSend it answered (In-Reply-To wins, then the most-recent References match; recipient fallback is the
  caller's job).
- **`lib/coldemail/classify.ts`** — rule-based detection (`ruleClassify`, `isUnsubscribeRequest`, precedence
  unsub > auto-reply > OOO > sentiment) that runs **always** (an unsubscribe is honoured with no API key),
  the class→status/stage maps (`classToConversationStatus`, `classToContactStage`, `classNeedsSuppression`),
  and `parseAiClass`. `classifyReply` layers an **optional** Claude refinement (interested vs not) that never
  overrides a rule-detected unsubscribe and degrades gracefully to the rule verdict with no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

### Send + webhook modules
- **`lib/coldemail/inbox-send.ts`** — `sendConversationReply`: builds a threaded reply, sends from the
  conversation's inbox SMTP (per-inbox creds decrypted, reusing `NxeonSmtpTransport`), logs an OUTBOUND
  `Message`, marks the conversation read. Errors (no creds / send failure) surface to the operator.
- **`lib/coldemail/webhooks.ts`** — `signPayload` (HMAC-SHA256 hex, sent as `X-Nxeon-Signature: sha256=…`),
  `fireWebhooks(event, payload)` (parallel, best-effort, records `lastStatus`), `testFireEndpoint`.

### Worker — the IMAP poller
`worker/coldemail-inbox.ts` → `coldEmailInboxPoll`, registered in `worker/index.ts` (~2 min, creds-gated,
send-independent so it runs regardless of the kill-switch). Per credentialed inbox it connects with
**`imapflow`**, fetches UIDs above `lastImapUid`, parses each with **`mailparser`**, and for every reply from
a **known contact**: upserts the `Conversation` + appends the INBOUND `Message` (idempotent on Message-ID),
moves the contact to `stage=REPLIED`, **halts the contact's remaining QUEUED sends** (→ `CANCELLED`), writes a
`REPLY` `EmailEvent` + `DeliverabilityEvent`, **classifies** the reply and sets `conversation.status` +
`contact.stage`, writes a **GLOBAL Suppression** on an unsubscribe, and **fires** reply / interested /
unsubscribe webhooks. Failures are isolated per-inbox and per-message; the UID bookmark always advances.

### Admin UI (under the "Cold Email" entry)
- **Inbox** (`/admin/coldemail/inbox`) — the flagship **unibox**: a dense, keyboard-friendly two-pane view.
  Left: a conversation list across every mailbox with filters (unread / by status / by inbox / by campaign) +
  a **Check for replies** button (`pollInboxesNow`). Right: the ordered thread, a **reply composer** that
  sends from the right inbox, and outcome controls (**Interested / Meeting booked / Not interested / Close**)
  that also advance the linked contact's pipeline stage. Shortcuts `j`/`k` move, `r` reply, `u` unread. Each
  conversation shows which inbox it belongs to.
- **Domains & inboxes** (`/admin/coldemail/domains`) — the inbox form gains a collapsible **SMTP + IMAP
  credentials** panel (passwords write-only, encrypted).
- **Webhooks** (`/admin/coldemail/webhooks`) — add/manage HMAC-signed endpoints with a **test-fire** button.
- Server actions in `lib/actions-coldemail-inbox.ts` (each `requireArea("platform")`): `sendReply`,
  `setConversationOutcome`, `setConversationRead`, `pollInboxesNow`, `saveWebhookEndpoint`,
  `deleteWebhookEndpoint`, `testWebhookEndpoint`; `saveInbox` in `lib/actions-coldemail.ts` extended with the
  encrypted creds. Nav gains **Inbox** (after Overview) and **Webhooks** (before Settings).

**Dependencies added:** `imapflow` + `mailparser` (already declared) are now imported; `@types/mailparser`
added to devDependencies for type coverage.

**Tests:** `test/coldemail-inbox.test.ts` — 15 cases over threading-header build, reply→send matching,
unsubscribe→suppression decision, and classification→status/stage mapping. `npx prisma generate` + `tsc
--noEmit` **0 errors**; full suite **1046 pass**. (A full `next build` needs a `DATABASE_URL`, unavailable in
the build worktree — verification is tsc + tests, per the build protocol.)

**Staging test:** `cd /opt/nxeon && bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh feature/coldemail-overhaul-inbox` (the bulk
kill-switch stays false; IMAP/reply-send stay inert until an inbox has real credentials).

**Guardrails honoured:** kill-switch untouched (off), no bulk send, creds + secrets encrypted, no `prisma db
push`, no `.env` edit, no deploy, all Phase 1/2/3 compliance + reputation isolation intact.
